senses.en_definition: Afraid of something perceived as dangerous or threatening.
Worried or anxious that something undesirable may happen.
Feeling reverent fear or awe arising from religious or moral belief.
Lacking the courage to do or face something because of fear.

messages.en: I've got to go to the dentist tomorrow. I'm scared to go on my own. Can you come with me?
Sure! What time's your appointment? I'll pick you up from your place.
Don't scare me like that! I'm just about to go to sleep.
I'm only joking. That story's made up.

senses.en_definition: A rope, cord, string, or strap used for tying, pulling, or fastening things.
A bond or tie of kinship or friendship.

collocations.en: strengthen bonds of kinship or friendship
sever ties of kinship or friendship

senses.en_definition: A historical monetary unit worth twenty-five sen.

collocations.en: a historical coin worth twenty-five sen

messages.en: Your shoelace has come undone. Tie it before you trip!
Oh, I hadn't noticed. Good thing you pointed it out. Hang on a sec while I tie it.
I tried calling you earlier, but the line kept cutting out.
I was in the lift. Try calling me again now, okay?
